summary: Cambricon-S already models 32 die-shared compute cores. SLIM die-level design describes >=32 PEs but has an 8/16-channel textual discrepancy. NVLLM-v2 evaluates at most 16 NAND engines. KVNAND has explicit per-plane PEs far above 32, but independent private-input command owners are not proved. None licenses transplanting AiF M32 waves, timing or numerical ABI.

owner_count_fact.128_correction: VIII-E holds 8 channels fixed and sweeps chips PER CHANNEL from 1 to 128. This is not 128 total chips. Sweep remains a modeled scaling study.

native_fact.core_ownership: One die-shared compute core is exclusively occupied by one plane at a time. Another plane can service normal reads for NPU weight computation. Two planes do not establish two independent GEMV contexts.
native_fact.primitive: Read-compute consumes one page-sized atomic weight matrix. Input sent to per-core input buffer; array to data register to cache register; PE computes; output buffer sends result to NPU. Data/cache stages pipeline requests.
native_fact.default_widths: W8A8; section VIII-B also evaluates W4A16. These are paper evaluation modes, not a public binary numeric ABI.
native_fact.broadcast: Section V-A explicitly broadcasts common input to cores sharing one channel; each retains a copy in its own input buffer.
native_fact.tiling: Columns divided across channels; rows divided across cores on a channel. Original S optimum global tile is 256 rows x 2048 columns; 4 cores/channel imply atomic 64 x 256 = 16384 coefficients/core.
native_fact.copies: Tiling divides weights between flash-compute fraction alpha and NPU-read fraction 1-alpha; no extra full weight-matrix replica is specified. Section VI separately duplicates the top approximately 1% INT8 values twice in spare-area protection metadata (163 protected values/page). It reports 722B ECC metadata within a 1664B spare region; this is not replica-based tensor placement.

unverified_contract: Per-core input/output buffer split and maximum legal input width
Public command/address fields for arbitrary multi-page complete-row GEMV and fringe flush
Accumulator width, reset semantics, result dtype, row scaling/rounding and external partial-sum merge ABI
Independent simultaneous private expert inputs on planes of a die; not implied by two planes
FIFO behavior/early whole-expert readiness within a multi-page matrix
Exact padding/replica policy for matrix edges
cambricon.portability_inference: YES for published modeled >=32 die cores. NOT a direct M32 AiF backend. Core-level atomic service is one 16KiB page, not an AiF four-plane 64KiB wave, nor an automatically combined two-plane 32KiB wave. Full-row arbitrary-shape numerical/native composition requires a separate contract. The 32-core topology itself is primary evidence.

native_fact.cluster: 2 x 2 planes share peripheral circuitry and synchronously return PB rows. Cluster FIFO and lane segment buffers feed an OoO-ECDP. A plane or MAC lane is not independently established as an arbitrary-job input context.
native_fact.buffer_scope: Section 4.2 NAND-CMOS subsystem totals; not a per-cluster or per-plane private input buffer
native_fact.widths: BF16 or INT8 dot products, optional widening; algorithm initializes a dot-product accumulator and returns final result after segment/correction completion.
native_fact.numeric_limit: No public fixed I8/I32 output/scale/reset external command ABI verified. Internal segment out-of-order readiness is not external partial-output readiness.
native_fact.multiVread: 3.1 explicitly accommodates MLC/TLC multi-Vread cycles through buffering; no class-resolved timing dataset or native placement command contract inferred.

nvllm.portability_inference: NO published evaluated >=32 independent cluster compute engines in this version: maximum 16 NAND OoO-ECDPs. 64 planes cannot substantiate 64 independent owners. Do not include four DRAM-side NPU engines as NAND owners.

owner_count_fact.topology_discrepancy: Table 2 says 16 channels while section 7.1 says 8. Both imply >=32 die-level PEs if four chips/channel is retained, but exact evaluated topology must not be silently resolved.
owner_count_fact.channel_level_alternative: Only 8 or 16 channel PEs; this alternative does not provide >=32 NAND compute owners.

native_fact.ownership: Die-level PE per NAND die accesses only weights on that die; multiplexes NAND data-register/ONFI data bus.
native_fact.batching: All B x L x dim_e input vectors cached (L=1); weights fetched once; output-stationary partial sums in output SRAM. Reduce commands collect sums across PEs via channel/on-chip bus.
native_fact.fused_FFN: Neuron-associated gate/up/down vectors scheduled together, with fused nonlinear computation. This is a different native execution/numerical contract from retaining full-vector A8 down-input quantization.
native_fact.multi_plane: Section 7.6 treats multi-plane read / independent multi-plane read as prospective improvement, not an already evaluated parallel-context primitive.

slim.portability_inference: YES for described die-level PE design and >=32 PE scale, with explicit 8-versus-16-channel source discrepancy. NO automatic transfer of AiF wave geometry, context timing, F32 output ABI or full-vector-A8 stage ordering. SRAM figure is total PE SRAM, not dedicated input SRAM.

owner_count_fact.logic_per_plane: KVNAND-C has 16 FMACs and an 8KB KV buffer per plane; G1 weight-GEMV sizing example uses 2 FMACs at 400MHz per plane.
owner_count_fact.qualification: Physical per-plane arithmetic resources are explicit. Independent private-input job/command/accumulator contexts for all planes are not established; do not identify these counts with independent AiF chip-owner graphs.

native_fact.input: QKV dataflow reads multi-plane pages together and broadcasts one input vector to all planes across dies. PE registers accumulate partials; complete outputs collect in global buffer and transfer to SoC.
native_fact.nonlinear: NPU handles activation and other nonlinear operations; MoE FFN evaluated with expert TP across dies and router on NPU.
native_fact.widths: Evaluation includes W8A8 and W4A16. Exact external output/reset/scaling command ABI not exposed by those labels.
native_fact.pipeline: Double-register pipeline overlaps page read and compute; KVNAND-C weight/KV reads compete for internal bandwidth.
native_fact.method: System-level SSDsim-based performance model with 3DFPIM/NVSim flash estimates, synthesized logic; V-B explicitly distinguishes study from RTL simulation.

kvnand.portability_inference: YES for >=32 explicitly instantiated plane PE resources, but NOT established as >=32 independently schedulable private-input whole-row owners. Per-die 32 planes and shared input/multi-plane read domains differ materially from AiF. No unchanged M32 cost/geometry transplant is justified.

cambricon_necessary_arithmetic_only.scope: Pure coefficient-capacity/work necessary bound for 32 cores at one 16KiB page per atomic service. Not a feasible Cambricon multi-page complete-row instruction, not a timing lower bound that accounts for all pipelines, and not a performance prediction.

universal_limits: These papers report architectural models / synthesized blocks, not evidence of manufactured commercial AiF-equivalent compute dies.
Storage CE/way/LUN count and plane count alone do not establish independent compute owners.
A hardware-owner count does not verify arbitrary whole-row shape, output/scaling/reset semantics or complete A8 barrier compatibility.
No new MAC, input context, independent plane operation, page-buffer replay, early reset or numerical format has been assumed.
